observations: Photo 0: A single solar panel with black frame, leaning against an interior wall near a glass door.
Panel shows rows of monocrystalline half-cut cells with visible busbars.
A watermark reading 'INNOSON GLOBAL GROUP' overlays the image, appears to be a photo credit/watermark, not a label on the panel itself.
No visible manufacturer label, wattage sticker, or model number plate on the panel itself.
Floor is tiled, indicating an indoor residential or office setting.
